name: Quad Cities Waterways
description: The 309 rivers, lakes and reservoirs of USGS's National Hydrography Dataset (NHD) that meet SCOUT's Quad Cities flood grid, cut at SCOUT's corners (longitude -90.6879 to -90.4252, latitude 41.4150 to 41.6242), which hold every cell of the FloodScenarios depth rasters: 29.3 km2 of water. NHD's large-scale Area layer gives its stream and river areas (FTYPE 460: 3 features, 25.9 km2 here, the largest the Mississippi's channel), and its large-scale Waterbody layer its lakes and ponds (FTYPE 390) and reservoirs (FTYPE 436); swamps and marshes (FTYPE 466) are not included. NHD's columns: GNIS_NAME (the name, empty for most), FTYPE, FCODE and AREASQKM (the whole feature's area in km2, before the cut). Queried from USGS's NHD service, https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/nhd/MapServer, layers 9 and 12, for the features that meet that box. komar41 acquired it for his FloodRisk example in urban-toolkit/curio#914, on 2026-10-13; this is his committed file, byte for byte (sha256 660fff3b2ee4124c7b381413e0daf5c08b9628e3aa9d8d9c483165bb6decf56c). USGS, public domain.
